academia:
Analyze this image to rebuild it as a layout. Output one JSON object and nothing else:
{"caption": "...", "items": [{"label": "...", "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "caption": "...", "text": "..."}]}
caption: one paragraph describing the whole image: medium and style, setting, lighting, colors and composition.
items: the elements worth placing, the largest and most important first, at most 20.
- label "character": a person, animal or creature. "object": a distinct object or region (a product, a car, a building, a table, the sky). "text": a legible sign, title or text block.
- bbox_2d: x from the left edge (0) to the right edge (1000), y from the top edge (0) to the bottom edge (1000); the box tightly encloses the element.
- caption: what the element looks like, at most 25 words (appearance, color, material, pose; for text, its typography and color). No names of real people.
- text: only for text items: every character exactly as written, in its own script, one item per text block with \n between its lines. Omit the field for other labels.
If there is no legible text, use no text items.
